title: Here’s How to Watch 2026 NBA Draft Live Online for Free
summary: The Washington Wizards are expected to draft BYU superstar AJ Dybantsa with the No. 1 pick on Tuesday (June 23).
contentText:

Now that the NBA Finals are over with the New York Knicks crowned as the new champions , the basketball league is already gearing up for next season with the Washington Wizards taking the No. 1 pick in the 2026 NBA Draft. It takes place at Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York, starting on Tuesday (June 23) and broadcasts live on ABC and ESPN .

How to Watch 2026 NBA Draft Live Online, At a Glance:

- Date: June 23-June 24

- Network: ABC, ESPN

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , Fubo , ESPN Unlimited

Watch 2026 NBA Draft on DirecTV

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During NBA Draft?

It’s likely there may be a number of celebrities and famous recording artists in attendance during the two-night NBA Draft event in Brooklyn. Be on the lookout for stars and celebrities, like Wizards fans Wale, Dave Bautista, David Chang and others.

How to Watch the 2026 NBA Draft Online

The first round of the NBA Draft takes place on Tuesday (June 23) at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT on ABC and ESPN, while the second round happens on the following day, Wednesday (June 24) at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT on ESPN. If you don’t have cable, you can still watch the 2026 NBA Draft live online with a free trial from DirecTV , Hulu + Live TV and Fubo .

FuboTV

With prices starting at $58.99 per month for the first month of service, Fubo’s “Pro” plan is a cable alternative streaming service that offers the NBA Draft broadcasts on ABC and ESPN. The plan features more than 200 other channels, including FOX Sports, MLB.TV, MLB Network, NHL Network, NFL Network and others. Fubo comes with a five-day free trial , so you can try out the service before you commit month-to-month.
